(Editor's note: The preface to the Astronomical Treatise in Xue Juzheng's History is originally missing from the Yongle Encyclopedia, but the chapters on solar eclipses, stellar changes, and related topics survive with their records intact and are fuller than the Heavenly Offices treatise in Ouyang Xiu's New History.)

《薛史天文志序》《永樂大典》原闕 is the standard reconstruction note that the Xue History Astronomical Treatise preface is originally missing from the Yongle Encyclopedia, not that both works are lost; the proposed after restores that scope while keeping the surviving-sections contrast.
In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month the moon was eclipsed within the Hare's Head celestial division.
In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month the moon was eclipsed within the Quail's Head celestial division.
鶉首 is the Jupiter-station Quail Head; Hare's Head invents a wrong station name. The proposed Quail's Head correctly names the celestial division of the lunar eclipse.
In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed within the Hare's Head asterism division.
In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed within the Quail's Head asterism division.
Same Chinese 鶉首 as r0002; the literal field likewise misreads it as Hare's Head. Quail's Head is the accurate station name for this eclipse locus.
After the third hour several streaks of white vapor followed one another westward until they dispersed after the third watch.
After the third point of the watch several streaks of white vapor followed one another westward until they dispersed after the third watch.

Preceding s0181 dates the omen at 一鼓初; 至三點後 continues that night-watch chronology as the third point within a watch, not a clock hour. Replacing “third hour” with “third point of the watch” corrects the misreading.
By after the third point of the night, afterward there were several streaks of white vapor, one after another streaming west, until after the third drum they dispersed.
After the third point, there were afterward several streaks of white vapor, one after another streaming west, until after the third drum they dispersed.

至三點後 means simply after the third point; “By after … of the night” is ungrammatical and invents a night scope, while 後有 is the separate afterward-existence clause. The proposed literal restores both segments cleanly.

units.zh: 梁太祖乾化元年，正月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first year of Qianhua under Liang Taizu, on the new moon of the first month (bingxu), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianhua of Emperor Taizu of Liang, on the first day of the first month (bingxu), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 時言事諸臣，多引漢高祖末年日蝕於歲首，太祖甚惡之，於是素服避正殿，百官各守本司。
units.en: The remonstrating ministers of the day mostly invoked the solar eclipse at the year's opening in the closing years of Han Gaozu; Taizu took this as a very bad omen, put on undyed robes, withdrew from the main audience hall, and ordered every official to remain at his post.
units.literal: At the time the remonstrating officials mostly cited the solar eclipse at the year's beginning in the final years of Emperor Gaozu of Han; Taizu greatly detested this, and therefore wore plain garments and avoided the main hall; the hundred officials each remained at their offices.

units.zh: 是日，有司奏：「雲初陰晦，事同不蝕。」
units.en: That day the responsible offices reported: "Clouds were dark from the outset, so in effect no eclipse was seen."
units.literal: On that day the responsible offices reported: "At first the clouds were dark and overcast; the matter is the same as if there were no eclipse."

units.zh: 百僚奉表稱賀。
units.en: The entire bureaucracy submitted memorials of congratulation.
units.literal: The hundred officials submitted memorials offering congratulations.

units.zh: 末帝寵德三年，十月辛未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third year of Chongde under the Last Emperor, on the new moon of the tenth month (xinwei), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year of Chongde of the Last Emperor, on the first day of the tenth month (xinwei), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 唐莊宗同光三年，四月癸亥朔，時有司奏：「日蝕在卯，主歲大旱。」
units.en: In the third year of Tongguang under Tang Zhuangzong, on the new moon of the fourth month (guihai), the astronomical office reported: "The eclipse falls in the mao hour and portends a severe drought for the year."
units.literal: In the third year of Tongguang of Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang, on the first day of the fourth month (guihai), at the time the responsible offices reported: "The solar eclipse is in mao; it presages a great drought for the year."

units.zh: 明宗天成元年，八月乙酉朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first year of Tiancheng under Mingzong, on the new moon of the eighth month (yiyou), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng of Emperor Mingzong, on the first day of the eighth month (yiyou), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年，八月己卯朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the second year, on the new moon of the eighth month (jimao), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the second year, on the first day of the eighth month (jimao), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年，二月丁丑朔，日蝕。
units.en: In the third year, on the new moon of the second month (dingchou), there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the third year, on the first day of the second month (dingchou), the sun was eclipsed.

units.zh: 其日陰雲不見，百官稱賀。
units.en: Clouds obscured the sky that day so the eclipse was not visible, and the officials offered congratulations.
units.literal: On that day clouds were overcast and it was not seen; the hundred officials offered congratulations.

units.zh: 長興元年，六月癸巳朔，日蝕。
units.en: In the first year of Changxing, on the new moon of the sixth month (guisi), there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the first year of Changxing, on the first day of the sixth month (guisi), the sun was eclipsed.

units.zh: 其日陰冥不見，至夕大雨。
units.en: The sky was dark and the eclipse could not be seen; heavy rain fell by evening.
units.literal: On that day it was dark and overcast and not seen; by evening there was heavy rain.

units.zh: 二年，十一月甲申朔，先是，司天奏：「朔日合食二分，伏緣所蝕微少，太陽光影相鑠，伏恐不辨虧闕，請其日不入閣。
units.en: In the second year, on the new moon of the eleventh month (jiashen), the astronomical office had earlier reported: "A two-tenths eclipse is due on the new moon; because the obscuration will be slight, sun and shadow may merge so that the bite in the disk cannot be made out—we ask that Your Majesty not enter the inner court that day.
units.literal: In the second year, on the first day of the eleventh month (jiashen), beforehand the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "On the new-moon day there should be an eclipse of two parts in ten; we submit that because the portion eclipsed is very slight, the sun's light and shadow will blend together, and we fear the deficiency will not be distinguishable; we request that on that day Your Majesty not enter the inner court.

units.zh: 百官守司。」
units.en: Officials are to remain at their posts."
units.literal: The hundred officials are to remain at their offices."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: [The request] was approved.

units.zh: 晉高祖天福二年，正月乙卯，先是，司天奏：「正月二日，太陽虧蝕，宜避正殿，開諸營門，蓋藏兵器，半月不宜用軍。」
units.en: In the second year of Tianfu under Jin Gaozu, on yimao of the first month, the astronomical office had reported in advance: "On the second day of the first month the sun will be eclipsed; the emperor should withdraw from the main hall, the camp gates should be opened, arms should be stored away, and troops should not be employed for half a month."
units.literal: In the second year of Tianfu of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, on yimao of the first month, beforehand the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "On the second day of the first month the sun will suffer eclipse; it is appropriate to avoid the main hall, open the gates of the various camps, cover and store weapons, and for half a month it is not appropriate to use the army."

units.zh: 是日太陽虧，十分內食三分，在尾宿十七度。
units.en: That day the sun was eclipsed: three parts in ten were covered, at the seventeenth degree of the Tail asterism.
units.literal: On that day the sun was eclipsed; within ten parts, three parts were eaten, at the seventeenth degree of the Tail mansion.

units.zh: 日出東方，以帶蝕三分，漸生，至卯時復滿。
units.en: The sun rose in the east with a three-part belt eclipse, then waxed back until by the mao hour it was whole again.
units.literal: The sun rose in the east with a belt-like eclipse of three parts; it gradually regenerated, and by the mao hour was full again.

units.zh: 三年，正月戊申朔，司天先奏，其日日蝕。
units.en: In the third year, on the new moon of the first month (wushen), the astronomical office had foretold an eclipse for that day.
units.literal: In the third year, on the first day of the first month (wushen), the Directorate of Astronomy had reported in advance that on that day the sun would be eclipsed.

units.zh: 至是日不蝕，內外稱賀。
units.en: When the day arrived there was no eclipse, and court and capital alike offered congratulations.
units.literal: When that day came there was no eclipse; inside and outside the court offered congratulations.

units.zh: 四年，七月庚子朔，時中書門下奏：「謹按舊禮：日有變，天子素服避正殿，太史以所司救日於社，陳五兵、五鼓、五麾，東戟西矛，南弩北楯，中央置鼓，服從其位，百職廢務，素服守司，重列於庭，每等異位，向日而立，明復而止。
units.en: In the fourth year, on the new moon of the seventh month (gengzi), the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "According to the ancient rites, when the sun shows an anomaly the emperor puts on undyed robes and leaves the main hall; the chief astrologer performs the sun-rescue rite at the soil altar, arraying five kinds of arms, five drums, and five banners—halberds east, spears west, crossbows south, shields north, with a drum in the center—each in prescribed dress; all offices suspend business, wear plain clothes and keep their posts, and line up in the courtyard by rank, each grade in its place, facing the sun until full daylight returns.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on the first day of the seventh month (gengzi), at the time the Secretariat and Chancellery reported: "We respectfully examine the old rites: when the sun undergoes change, the Son of Heaven wears plain garments and avoids the main hall; the Grand Astrologer, according to his office, performs the rite to rescue the sun at the altar of the soil, displaying the five weapons, five drums, and five banners—halberds to the east, spears to the west, crossbows to the south, shields to the north, with a drum placed in the center—garments according to position; the hundred offices suspend duties, wear plain garments and remain at their offices, arrayed in ranks in the court, each grade in a different position, standing facing the sun until brightness is restored, then stopping.

units.zh: 今所司法物，鹹不能具，去歲正旦日食，唯謹藏兵仗，皇帝避正殿素食，百官守司。
units.en: The ritual implements now in the keeping of the offices cannot all be supplied; at last year's New Year eclipse we could only store arms with care, have the emperor withdraw to plain fare in a side hall, and keep officials at their posts.
units.literal: The ritual objects in the charge of the offices today cannot all be provided; at last year's New Year's Day solar eclipse, we only carefully stored away weapons, the emperor avoided the main hall and ate plain food, and the hundred officials remained at their offices.

units.zh: 今且欲依近禮施行。」
units.en: We propose to follow the simplified rites used in recent years."
units.literal: For now we wish to carry out the recent rites."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was adopted.
units.literal: [The memorial] was approved.

units.zh: 七年，四月甲寅朔，是日百官守司，太陽不蝕，上表稱賀。
units.en: In the seventh year, on the new moon of the fourth month (jiayin), officials kept their posts as ordered; the sun was not eclipsed, and congratulatory memorials were sent up.
units.literal: In the seventh year, on the first day of the fourth month (jiayin), on that day the hundred officials remained at their offices; the sun was not eclipsed, and memorials of congratulation were submitted.

units.zh: 八年，四月戊申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the eighth year, on the new moon of the fourth month (wushen), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the eighth year, on the first day of the fourth month (wushen), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 少帝開運元年，九月庚午朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the first year of Kaiyun under the Young Emperor, on the new moon of the ninth month (gengwu), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaiyun of the Young Emperor, on the first day of the ninth month (gengwu), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年，八月甲子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the second year, on the new moon of the eighth month (jiazi), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the second year, on the first day of the eighth month (jiazi), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 三年，二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third year, on the new moon of the second month (renxu), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year, on the first day of the second month (renxu), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 漢隱帝乾祐三年，十一月甲子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the third year of Qianyou under Han Yindi, on the new moon of the eleventh month (jiazi), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the third year of Qianyou of Emperor Yindi of Han, on the first day of the eleventh month (jiazi), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 周太祖廣順二年，四月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In the second year of Guangshun under Zhou Taizu, on the new moon of the fourth month (bingxu), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangshun of Emperor Taizu of Zhou, on the first day of the fourth month (bingxu), there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 月食
units.en: Lunar Eclipses
units.literal: Lunar Eclipses

units.zh: 梁太祖開平四年，十二月十四日夜，先是，司天奏：「是日月蝕，不宜用兵。」
units.en: In the fourth year of Kaiping under Liang Taizu, on the night of the fourteenth of the twelfth month, the astronomical office had reported in advance: "A lunar eclipse is due; troops should not be deployed."
units.literal: In the fourth year of Kaiping of Emperor Taizu of Liang, on the night of the fourteenth day of the twelfth month, beforehand the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "On this day there will be a lunar eclipse; it is not appropriate to use the army."

units.zh: 時王景仁方總大軍北伐，追之不及。
units.en: Wang Jingren was already leading the main army north; the warning could not reach him in time.
units.literal: At the time Wang Jingren was just then commanding the great army on a northern campaign; [the order] could not overtake him.

units.zh: 至五年正月二日，果為後唐莊宗大敗於柏鄉。
units.en: On the second day of the first month of the fifth year he was indeed routed by Later Tang Zhuangzong at Boxiang.
units.literal: By the second day of the first month of the fifth year, he was indeed greatly defeated by Emperor Zhuangzong of Later Tang at Boxiang.

units.zh: 唐莊宗同光三年，三月戊申，月蝕。
units.en: In the third year of Tongguang under Tang Zhuangzong, on wushen of the third month, there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the third year of Tongguang of Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang, on wushen of the third month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 九月甲辰，月蝕。
units.en: On jiachen of the ninth month there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: On jiachen of the ninth month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 明宗天成三年，十二月乙卯，月蝕。
units.en: In the third year of Tiancheng under Mingzong, on yimao of the twelfth month, there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the third year of Tiancheng of Emperor Mingzong, on yimao of the twelfth month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 四年，六月癸丑望，月食。
units.en: In the fourth year, on the full moon (guichou) of the sixth month, the moon was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on the full moon of guichou of the sixth month, there was a lunar eclipse.

units.zh: 十二月庚戌，月蝕。
units.en: On gengxu of the twelfth month there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: On gengxu of the twelfth month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 晉高祖天福二年，七月丙寅，月蝕。
units.en: In the second year of Tianfu under Jin Gaozu, on bingyin of the seventh month there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianfu of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, on bingyin of the seventh month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 五年，十一月丁丑，月蝕鶉首之分。
units.en: In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month the moon was eclipsed within the Quail's Head celestial division.
units.literal: In the fifth year, on dingchou of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed within the Quail's Head asterism division.

units.zh: 少帝開運元年，三月戊子，月蝕。
units.en: In the first year of Kaiyun under the Young Emperor, on wuzi of the third month there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaiyun of the Young Emperor, on wuzi of the third month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 九月丙戌，月蝕。
units.en: On bingxu of the ninth month there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: On bingxu of the ninth month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 漢高祖天福十二年，十二月乙未，月食。
units.en: In the twelfth year of Tianfu under Han Gaozu, on yiwei of the twelfth month the moon was eclipsed.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Tianfu of Emperor Gaozu of Han, on yiwei of the twelfth month, there was a lunar eclipse.

units.zh: 周世宗顯德三年，正月戊申，月蝕。
units.en: In the third year of Xiande under Zhou Shizong, on wushen of the first month, there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the third year of Xiande of Emperor Shizong of Zhou, on wushen of the first month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: 五年，十一月辛未，月蝕。
units.en: In the fifth year, on xinwei of the eleventh month, there was a lunar eclipse.
units.literal: In the fifth year, on xinwei of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed.

units.zh: ◎月暈
units.en: Lunar Halos
units.literal: ◎ Lunar Halos

units.zh: 唐明宗天成元年，十一月，月暈匝火、木。
units.en: In the first year of Tiancheng under Tang Mingzong, in the eleventh month the moon showed a halo ringed around the stations of Fire and Wood.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng of Emperor Mingzong of Tang, in the eleventh month, the moon had a halo encircling the Fire and Wood [planetary stations].

units.zh: ◎彗孛梁太祖乾化二年，四月甲戌夜，彗見於靈臺之西。
units.en: Comets and Broom Stars. In the second year of Qianhua under Liang Taizu, on the night of jiaxu in the fourth month, a comet appeared west of the Observatory Terrace.
units.literal: ◎ Comets and Broom Stars. In the second year of Qianhua of Emperor Taizu of Liang, on the night of jiaxu of the fourth month, a comet appeared west of the Observatory Terrace.

units.zh: 唐明宗天成三年，十月庚午夜，西南有孛，長丈餘，東南指，在牛宿五度。
units.en: In the third year of Tiancheng under Tang Mingzong, on the night of gengwu in the tenth month, a broom star more than ten feet long appeared in the southwest, its tail toward the southeast, at the fifth degree of the Ox asterism.
units.literal: In the third year of Tiancheng of Emperor Mingzong of Tang, on the night of gengwu of the tenth month, in the southwest there was a broom star more than a zhang in length, pointing southeast, at the fifth degree of the Ox mansion.

units.zh: 末帝清泰三年，九月己丑，彗出虛、危，長尺餘，形細微，經天壘、哭星。
units.en: In the third year of Qingtai under the Last Emperor, on jichou of the ninth month a comet rose from the Emptiness and Rooftop asterisms, a little over a foot long and faint in form, crossing the Celestial Ramparts and the Weeping Star.
units.literal: In the third year of Qingtai of the Last Emperor, on jichou of the ninth month, a comet issued from Emptiness and Rooftop, more than a chi in length, its form slight and fine, passing through the Celestial Ramparts and the Weeping Star.

units.zh: 晉高祖天福六年，九月，有彗星長丈餘。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu under Jin Gaozu, in the ninth month a comet appeared more than ten feet long.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, in the ninth month, there was a comet more than a zhang in length.

units.zh: 八年，十月庚戌夜，有彗見於東方，西指，尾長一丈，在角九度。
units.en: In the eighth year, on the night of gengxu in the tenth month, a comet appeared in the east with its tail toward the west, ten feet long, at the ninth degree of the Horn asterism.
units.literal: In the eighth year, on the night of gengxu of the tenth month, a comet was seen in the east, pointing west; its tail was one zhang in length, at the ninth degree of the Horn mansion.

units.zh: 周太祖顯德三年，正月壬戌夜，有星孛於參角，其芒指於東南。
units.en: In the third year of Xiande under Zhou Taizu, on the night of renxu in the first month a broom star appeared at the corner of the Three Stars asterism, its rays toward the southeast.
units.literal: In the third year of Xiande of Emperor Taizu of Zhou, on the night of renxu of the first month, there was a broom star at the corner of the Three Stars mansion; its rays pointed toward the southeast.

units.zh: ◎五星淩犯梁太祖開平二年，正月乙亥，歲星犯月。
units.en: Encroachments of the Five Planets. In the second year of Kaiping under Liang Taizu, on yihai of the first month Jupiter crossed the moon's path.
units.literal: ◎ Encroachments of the Five Planets. In the second year of Kaiping of Emperor Taizu of Liang, on yihai of the first month, the Year Star encroached upon the moon.

units.zh: 乾化二年，五月壬戌，熒惑犯心大星，去心四度，順行。
units.en: In the second year of Qianhua, on renxu of the fifth month Mars encroached on the chief star of the Heart asterism, four degrees from the Heart, in direct motion.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianhua, on renxu of the fifth month, Mars encroached upon the great star of the Heart mansion, four degrees from the Heart, moving in direct motion.

units.zh: 占曰：「心為帝王之星。」
units.en: The omen text reads: "The Heart is the star of the sovereign."
units.literal: The prognostication says: "The Heart is the star of the Son of Heaven."

units.zh: 其年六月五日，帝崩。
units.en: That year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, the emperor died.
units.literal: In that year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, the emperor died.

units.zh: 唐莊宗同光二年，八月戊子，熒惑犯星。
units.en: In the second year of Tongguang under Tang Zhuangzong, on wuzi of the eighth month Mars encroached on the Star asterism.
units.literal: In the second year of Tongguang of Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang, on wuzi of the eighth month, Mars encroached upon the Star mansion.

units.zh: 三年，三月丙申，熒惑犯上相。
units.en: In the third year, on bingshen of the third month Mars encroached on the Upper Minister star.
units.literal: In the third year, on bingshen of the third month, Mars encroached upon the Upper Minister star.

units.zh: 四月甲申，熒惑犯左執法。
units.en: On jiashen of the fourth month Mars encroached on the Left Enforcer star.
units.literal: On jiashen of the fourth month, Mars encroached upon the Left Enforcer star.

units.zh: 六月丙寅，歲犯右執法。
units.en: On bingyin of the sixth month Jupiter encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: On bingyin of the sixth month, the Year Star encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 九月己亥，熒惑在江東犯第一星。
units.en: On jihai of the ninth month Mars, east of the River, encroached on the first star.
units.literal: On jihai of the ninth month, Mars, east of the River, encroached upon the first star.

units.zh: 〈（案《歐陽史》：九月丙辰，太白、歲相犯。
units.en: (Editor's note: Ouyang Xiu's History records that on bingchen of the ninth month Venus and Jupiter came into mutual conjunction.)
units.literal: (Note: The Ouyang History records: On bingchen of the ninth month, Venus and the Year Star mutually encroached.)

units.zh: 薛書不載，疑有闕文。）〉
units.en: Xue Juzheng's History does not include this entry; the text here may be defective.)〉
units.literal: The Xue History does not record this; there is suspected missing text.)〉

units.zh: 明宗天成元年，八月癸卯，太白犯心大星。
units.en: In the first year of Tiancheng under Mingzong, on guimao of the eighth month Venus encroached on the chief star of the Heart asterism.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng of Emperor Mingzong, on guimao of the eighth month, Venus encroached upon the great star of the Heart mansion.

units.zh: 辛亥，熒惑犯上將。
units.en: On xinhai Mars encroached on the Upper General star.
units.literal: On xinhai, Mars encroached upon the Upper General star.

units.zh: 九月庚午，熒惑犯右執法，已卯，熒惑犯左執法。
units.en: On gengwu of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Right Enforcer; on jimao Mars encroached on the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On gengwu of the ninth month, Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer star; on jimao, Mars encroached upon the Left Enforcer star.

units.zh: 十月戊子，熒惑犯上相。
units.en: On wuzi of the tenth month Mars encroached on the Upper Minister star.
units.literal: On wuzi of the tenth month, Mars encroached upon the Upper Minister star.

units.zh: 十二月，熒惑犯氐。
units.en: In the twelfth month Mars encroached on the Base asterism.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Mars encroached upon the Base mansion.

units.zh: 二年，正月甲戌，熒惑、歲相犯。
units.en: In the second year, on jiaxu of the first month Mars and Jupiter came into mutual conjunction.
units.literal: In the second year, on jiaxu of the first month, Mars and the Year Star mutually encroached.

units.zh: 二月辛卯，熒惑犯鍵閉。
units.en: On xinmao of the second month Mars encroached on the Key and Barrier stars.
units.literal: On xinmao of the second month, Mars encroached upon the Key and Barrier stars.

units.zh: 三月，熒惑犯上相。
units.en: In the third month Mars encroached on the Upper Minister star.
units.literal: In the third month, Mars encroached upon the Upper Minister star.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，熒惑犯房。
units.en: On xinchou of the sixth month Mars encroached on the Room asterism.
units.literal: On xinchou of the sixth month, Mars encroached upon the Room mansion.

units.zh: 九月壬子，歲犯房。
units.en: On renzi of the ninth month Jupiter encroached on the Room asterism.
units.literal: On renzi of the ninth month, the Year Star encroached upon the Room mansion.

units.zh: 三年，正月壬申，太白、熒惑合於奎。
units.en: In the third year, on renshen of the first month Venus and Mars conjoined in the Striding Legs asterism.
units.literal: In the third year, on renshen of the first month, Venus and Mars conjoined at the Striding Legs mansion.

units.zh: 閏八月癸卯，熒惑犯上將。
units.en: On guimao of the intercalary eighth month Mars encroached on the Upper General star.
units.literal: On guimao of the intercalary eighth month, Mars encroached upon the Upper General star.

units.zh: 乙卯，熒惑犯右執法。
units.en: On yimao Mars encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: On yimao, Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 庚午，太白犯左執法。
units.en: On gengwu Venus encroached on the Left Enforcer star.
units.literal: On gengwu, Venus encroached upon the Left Enforcer star.

units.zh: 九月庚辰，鎮、歲合於箕。
units.en: On gengchen of the ninth month Saturn and Jupiter conjoined in the Winnowing Basket asterism.
units.literal: On gengchen of the ninth month, Saturn and the Year Star conjoined at the Winnowing Basket mansion.

units.zh: 辛巳，太白、熒惑合於軫。
units.en: On xinsi Venus and Mars conjoined in the Chariot Shaft asterism.
units.literal: On xinsi, Venus and Mars conjoined at the Chariot Shaft mansion.

units.zh: 十二月壬寅，熒惑犯房，太白、歲相犯於鬥。
units.en: On renyin of the twelfth month Mars encroached on the Room asterism; Venus and Jupiter came into mutual conjunction at the Dipper asterism.
units.literal: On renyin of the twelfth month, Mars encroached upon the Room mansion; Venus and the Year Star mutually encroached at the Dipper mansion.

units.zh: 四年，三月壬辰，歲犯牛。
units.en: In the fourth year, on renchen of the third month Jupiter encroached on the Ox asterism.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on renchen of the third month, the Year Star encroached upon the Ox mansion.

units.zh: 九月丙子，熒惑入哭星。
units.en: On bingzi of the ninth month Mars entered the Weeping Star.
units.literal: On bingzi of the ninth month, Mars entered the Weeping Star.

units.zh: 長興元年，六月乙卯，太白犯天樽。
units.en: In the first year of Changxing, on yimao of the sixth month Venus encroached on the Celestial Wine Jar.
units.literal: In the first year of Changxing, on yimao of the sixth month, Venus encroached upon the Celestial Wine Jar.

units.zh: 十一月壬戌，熒惑犯氐。
units.en: On renxu of the eleventh month Mars encroached on the Base asterism.
units.literal: On renxu of the eleventh month, Mars encroached upon the Base mansion.

units.zh: 十二月丙辰，熒惑犯天江。
units.en: On bingchen of the twelfth month Mars encroached on the Celestial River.
units.literal: On bingchen of the twelfth month, Mars encroached upon the Celestial River.

units.zh: 二年，正月乙亥，太白犯羽林。
units.en: In the second year, on yihai of the first month Venus encroached on the Feathered Forest guard stars.
units.literal: In the second year, on yihai of the first month, Venus encroached upon the Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 四月甲寅，熒惑犯羽林。
units.en: On jiayin of the fourth month Mars encroached on the Feathered Forest guard stars.
units.literal: On jiayin of the fourth month, Mars encroached upon the Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 八月，辰犯端門。
units.en: In the eighth month the planet Chen encroached on the High Gate star.
units.literal: In the eighth month, [the planet] Chen encroached upon the High Gate.

units.zh: 十一月丙戌，太白犯鍵閉。
units.en: On bingxu of the eleventh month Venus encroached on the Key and Barrier stars.
units.literal: On bingxu of the eleventh month, Venus encroached upon the Key and Barrier stars.

units.zh: 三年，四月庚辰，熒惑犯積屍。
units.en: In the third year, on gengchen of the fourth month Mars encroached on the Heap of Corpses star.
units.literal: In the third year, on gengchen of the fourth month, Mars encroached upon the Heap of Corpses star.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，太白犯哭星。
units.en: On gengyin of the ninth month Venus encroached on the Weeping Star.
units.literal: On gengyin of the ninth month, Venus encroached upon the Weeping Star.

units.zh: 十一月己亥，太白犯壁壘。
units.en: On jihai of the eleventh month Venus encroached on the Ramparts and Walls stars.
units.literal: On jihai of the eleventh month, Venus encroached upon the Ramparts and Walls stars.

units.zh: 四年，八月己未，五鼓三籌，熒惑近天高星，歲星近司怪，太白近軒轅大星。
units.en: In the fourth year, on jiwei of the eighth month, at the third watch after the fifth drum, Mars approached the Heaven's Height star, Jupiter approached the Director of Anomalies, and Venus approached the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on jiwei of the eighth month, at the third watch of the fifth drum, Mars drew near the Heaven's Height star, the Year Star drew near the Director of Anomalies star, and Venus drew near the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 〈（案《歐陽史》：九月辛巳，太白犯右執法。
units.en: (Editor's note: Ouyang Xiu's History records that on xinsi of the ninth month Venus encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: (Note: The Ouyang History records: On xinsi of the ninth month, Venus encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 《薛書》不載。）〉
units.en: Xue Juzheng's History does not include this entry.)〉

units.zh: 末帝清泰元年，六月甲戌，太白犯右執法。
units.en: In the first year of Qingtai under the Last Emperor, on jiaxu of the sixth month Venus encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: In the first year of Qingtai of the Last Emperor, on jiaxu of the sixth month, Venus encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 晉天福元年，三月壬子，熒惑犯積屍。
units.en: In the first year of Tianfu under Jin, on renzi of the third month Mars encroached on the Heap of Corpses star.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianfu of Jin, on renzi of the third month, Mars encroached upon the Heap of Corpses star.

units.zh: 四年，四月辛巳，太白犯東井北轅。
units.en: In the fourth year, on xinsi of the fourth month Venus encroached on the Eastern Well's northern crossbar.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on xinsi of the fourth month, Venus encroached upon the northern crossbar of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 甲申，太白犯五諸侯。
units.en: On jiashen Venus encroached on the Five Feudal Lords stars.
units.literal: On jiashen, Venus encroached upon the Five Feudal Lords stars.

units.zh: 五月丁未，太白犯輿鬼中星。
units.en: On dingwei of the fifth month Venus encroached on the central star of the Chariot Ghost.
units.literal: On dingwei of the fifth month, Venus encroached upon the central star of the Chariot Ghost.

units.zh: 六年，八月辛卯，太白犯軒轅。
units.en: In the sixth year, on xinmao of the eighth month Venus encroached on the Chariot Shaft asterism.
units.literal: In the sixth year, on xinmao of the eighth month, Venus encroached upon the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 九月己卯，熒惑犯上將。
units.en: On jimao of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Upper General star.
units.literal: On jimao of the ninth month, Mars encroached upon the Upper General star.

units.zh: 八年，八月丙子，熒惑犯右掖。
units.en: In the eighth year, on bingzi of the eighth month Mars encroached on the Right Flank Gate.
units.literal: In the eighth year, on bingzi of the eighth month, Mars encroached upon the Right Flank.

units.zh: 十月丙辰，熒惑犯進賢。
units.en: On bingchen of the tenth month Mars encroached on the Advancement of Worthies star.
units.literal: On bingchen of the tenth month, Mars encroached upon the Advancement of Worthies star.

units.zh: 開運元年，二月壬戌，太白犯昴。
units.en: In the first year of Kaiyun, on renxu of the second month Venus encroached on the Hairy Head asterism.
units.literal: In the first year of Kaiyun, on renxu of the second month, Venus encroached upon the Hairy Head mansion.

units.zh: 己巳，熒惑犯天鑰。
units.en: On jisi Mars encroached on the Celestial Key star.
units.literal: On jisi, Mars encroached upon the Celestial Key star.

units.zh: 四月丁巳，太白犯五諸侯。
units.en: On dingsi of the fourth month Venus encroached on the Five Feudal Lords stars.
units.literal: On dingsi of the fourth month, Venus encroached upon the Five Feudal Lords stars.

units.zh: 七月甲申，太白犯東井。
units.en: On jiashen of the seventh month Venus encroached on the Eastern Well asterism.
units.literal: On jiashen of the seventh month, Venus encroached upon the Eastern Well mansion.

units.zh: 八月甲辰，熒惑入南斗。
units.en: On jiachen of the eighth month Mars entered the Southern Dipper asterism.
units.literal: On jiachen of the eighth month, Mars entered the Southern Dipper mansion.

units.zh: 十月壬戌，滎惑犯哭星。
units.en: On renxu of the tenth month Mars encroached on the Weeping Star.
units.literal: On renxu of the tenth month, Mars encroached upon the Weeping Star.

units.zh: 〈（案：此條《歐陽史》不載。）〉
units.en: (Editor's note: Ouyang Xiu's History does not include this entry.)〉
units.literal: (Note: This entry is not recorded in the Ouyang History.)〉

units.zh: 十二月，太白犯辰。
units.en: In the twelfth month Venus encroached on the Chen star.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Venus encroached upon the Chen star.

units.zh: 二年，八月甲戌，歲犯東井。
units.en: In the second year, on jiaxu of the eighth month Jupiter encroached on the Eastern Well asterism.
units.literal: In the second year, on jiaxu of the eighth month, the Year Star encroached upon the Eastern Well mansion.

units.zh: 九月甲寅，太白犯南斗魁。
units.en: On jiayin of the ninth month Venus encroached on the chief star of the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On jiayin of the ninth month, Venus encroached upon the leader of the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 十一月甲午朔，太白犯哭星。
units.en: On the new moon of the eleventh month (jiawu) Venus encroached on the Weeping Star.
units.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month (jiawu), Venus encroached upon the Weeping Star.

units.zh: 漢天福十二年，十月己丑，太白犯亢距星。
units.en: In the twelfth year of Tianfu under Han, on jichou of the tenth month Venus encroached on the Neck asterism's distance star.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Tianfu of Han, on jichou of the tenth month, Venus encroached upon the distance star of the Neck mansion.

units.zh: 乾祐元年，八月己丑，鎮星入太微西垣。
units.en: In the first year of Qianyou, on jichou of the eighth month Saturn entered the western wall of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianyou, on jichou of the eighth month, Saturn entered the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 戊戌，歲犯右執法。
units.en: On wuxu Jupiter encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: On wuxu, the Year Star encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 十月丁丑，歲犯左執法。
units.en: On dingchou of the tenth month Jupiter encroached on the Left Enforcer star.
units.literal: On dingchou of the tenth month, the Year Star encroached upon the Left Enforcer star.

units.zh: 二年，九月壬寅，太白犯右執法。
units.en: In the second year, on renyin of the ninth month Venus encroached on the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: In the second year, on renyin of the ninth month, Venus encroached upon the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 庚戌，太白犯鎮。
units.en: On gengxu Venus encroached on Saturn.
units.literal: On gengxu, Venus encroached upon Saturn.

units.zh: 丁卯，太白犯歲。
units.en: On dingmao Venus encroached on Jupiter.
units.literal: On dingmao, Venus encroached upon the Year Star.

units.zh: 十一月，鎮星始出太微之左掖門。
units.en: In the eleventh month Saturn finally left the Supreme Palace Enclosure by the Left Flank Gate.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Saturn first emerged from the Left Flank Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

units.zh: 自元年八月己丑，鎮星入太微垣，犯上將、左右執法、內屏、謁者，勾己往來，凡四百四十三日方出左掖。
units.en: Since jichou of the eighth month in the first year Saturn had been inside the Supreme Palace Enclosure, crossing the Upper General, the Left and Right Enforcers, the Inner Screen, and the Usher stars in looping retrograde motion; only after four hundred forty-three days did it exit by the Left Flank.
units.literal: From jichou of the eighth month of the first year, Saturn entered the rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, encroaching upon the Upper General, the Left and Right Enforcers, the Inner Screen, and the Usher stars, moving back and forth in hook-shaped motion; in all, after four hundred forty-three days it emerged from the Left Flank.

units.zh: 三年，六月乙卯，鎮犯左掖。
units.en: In the third year, on yimao of the sixth month Saturn encroached on the Left Flank Gate.
units.literal: In the third year, on yimao of the sixth month, Saturn encroached upon the Left Flank.

units.zh: 七月甲申，熒惑犯司怪。
units.en: On jiashen of the seventh month Mars encroached on the Director of Anomalies star.
units.literal: On jiashen of the seventh month, Mars encroached upon the Director of Anomalies star.

units.zh: 八月癸卯，太白犯房。
units.en: On guimao of the eighth month Venus encroached on the Room asterism.
units.literal: On guimao of the eighth month, Venus encroached upon the Room mansion.

units.zh: 庚戌，太白犯心大星。
units.en: On gengxu Venus encroached on the chief star of the Heart asterism.
units.literal: On gengxu, Venus encroached upon the great star of the Heart mansion.

units.zh: 十月辛酉，太白犯歲。
units.en: On xinyou of the tenth month Venus encroached on Jupiter.
units.literal: On xinyou of the tenth month, Venus encroached upon the Year Star.

units.zh: 周廣順元年，二月丁巳，歲犯鹹池。
units.en: In the first year of Guangshun under Zhou, on dingsi of the second month Jupiter encroached on the Salty Pool asterism.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, on dingsi of the second month, the Year Star encroached upon the Salty Pool.

units.zh: 己未，熒惑犯五諸侯。
units.en: On jiwei Mars encroached on the Five Feudal Lords stars.
units.literal: On jiwei, Mars encroached upon the Five Feudal Lords stars.

units.zh: 三月甲子，歲守心。
units.en: On jiazi of the third month Jupiter stationed itself at the Heart asterism.
units.literal: On jiazi of the third month, the Year Star stationed at the Heart mansion.

units.zh: 己卯，熒惑犯鬼。
units.en: On jimao Mars encroached on the Ghost asterism.
units.literal: On jimao, Mars encroached upon the Ghost mansion.

units.zh: 壬午，熒惑犯天戶。
units.en: On renwu Mars encroached on the Celestial Gate star.
units.literal: On renwu, Mars encroached upon the Celestial Gate star.

units.zh: 四月甲午，歲犯鉤鈐。
units.en: On jiawu of the fourth month Jupiter encroached on the Curved Halberds stars.
units.literal: On jiawu of the fourth month, the Year Star encroached upon the Curved Halberds stars.

units.zh: 二年七月，熒惑犯井鉞。
units.en: In the seventh month of the second year Mars encroached on the Well Battle-axe star.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, Mars encroached upon the Well Battle-axe star.

units.zh: 八月乙未，熒惑犯天樽。
units.en: On yiwei of the eighth month Mars encroached on the Celestial Wine Jar.
units.literal: On yiwei of the eighth month, Mars encroached upon the Celestial Wine Jar.

units.zh: 九月辛酉，熒惑犯鬼。
units.en: On xinyou of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Ghost asterism.
units.literal: On xinyou of the ninth month, Mars encroached upon the Ghost mansion.

units.zh: 庚辰，熒惑掩右執法。
units.en: On gengchen Mars occulted the Right Enforcer star.
units.literal: On gengchen, Mars covered the Right Enforcer star.

units.zh: 十月壬辰，太白犯進賢。
units.en: On renchen of the tenth month Venus encroached on the Advancement of Worthies star.
units.literal: On renchen of the tenth month, Venus encroached upon the Advancement of Worthies star.

units.zh: 三年，四月乙丑，熒惑犯靈臺。
units.en: In the third year, on yichou of the fourth month Mars encroached on the Spirit Terrace asterism.
units.literal: In the third year, on yichou of the fourth month, Mars encroached upon the Spirit Terrace.

units.zh: 五月辛巳，熒惑犯上將。
units.en: On xinsi of the fifth month Mars encroached on the Upper General star.
units.literal: On xinsi of the fifth month, Mars encroached upon the Upper General star.

units.zh: 顯德六年，六月庚子，熒惑與心大星合度，光芒相射。
units.en: In the sixth year of Xiande, on gengzi of the sixth month Mars and the chief star of the Heart stood at the same degree, their light beams crossing.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Xiande, on gengzi of the sixth month, Mars and the great star of the Heart mansion shared the same degree; their rays shot at each other.

units.zh: 先是，熒惑勾己於房、心間，凡數月，至是與心大星合度，是夜順行。
units.en: For months Mars had looped in retrograde between the Room and Heart asterisms; now it joined the Heart's chief star in longitude, and that night resumed direct motion.
units.literal: Before this, Mars had moved in hook-shaped motion between the Room and Heart mansions for several months; reaching this point it shared the degree with the great star of the Heart, and that night moved in direct motion.

units.zh: ◎星晝見唐同光三年，六月己巳，太白晝見。
units.en: Stars Seen by Day. In the third year of Tongguang under Tang, on jisi of the sixth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: ◎ Stars Seen by Day. In the third year of Tongguang of Tang, on jisi of the sixth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 天成元年，七月庚申，太白晝見。
units.en: In the first year of Tiancheng, on gengshen of the seventh month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng, on gengshen of the seventh month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 長興二年，五月己亥，歲星晝見。
units.en: In the second year of Changxing, on jihai of the fifth month Jupiter was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the second year of Changxing, on jihai of the fifth month, the Year Star was seen by day.

units.zh: 閏五月己巳，歲星晝見。
units.en: On jisi of the intercalary fifth month Jupiter was visible in daylight.
units.literal: On jisi of the intercalary fifth month, the Year Star was seen by day.

units.zh: 八月戊子，太白晝見。
units.en: On wuzi of the eighth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: On wuzi of the eighth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 三年，十月壬申，太白晝見。
units.en: In the third year, on renshen of the tenth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the third year, on renshen of the tenth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 四年，五月癸卯，太白晝見。
units.en: In the fourth year, on guimao of the fifth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the fourth year, on guimao of the fifth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 清泰元年，五月己未，太白晝見。
units.en: In the first year of Qingtai, on jiwei of the fifth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the first year of Qingtai, on jiwei of the fifth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 漢天福十三年，四月丙子，太白晝見。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Tianfu under Han, on bingzi of the fourth month Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianfu of Han, on bingzi of the fourth month, Venus was seen by day.

units.zh: 乾祐二年，四月壬午，太白晝見，
units.en: In the second year of Qianyou, on renwu of the fourth month Venus was visible in daylight,
units.literal: In the second year of Qianyou, on renwu of the fourth month, Venus was seen by day,

units.zh: 周廣順二年，二月庚寅，太白經天。
units.en: In the second year of Guangshun under Zhou, on gengyin of the second month Venus crossed the meridian at culmination.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, on gengyin of the second month, Venus crossed the sky.

units.zh: ◎流星
units.en: Shooting Stars
units.literal: ◎ Shooting Stars

units.zh: 梁乾化元年，十一月甲辰，東方有流星如數升器，出畢宿口，曳光三丈餘，有聲如雷。
units.en: In the first year of Qianhua under Liang, on jiachen of the eleventh month a meteor like a multi-pint vessel appeared in the east, emerging from the Net asterism's opening, trailing light for more than thirty feet with a thunderous roar.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianhua of Liang, on jiachen of the eleventh month, in the east there was a shooting star like a vessel of several sheng; it issued from the mouth of the Net mansion, trailing light for more than three zhang, with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 唐長興二年，九月丙戌夜，二鼓初，東北方有小流星入北斗魁滅。
units.en: In the second year of Changxing under Tang, on the night of bingxu in the ninth month, at the second watch a small meteor entered the Dipper's leader and vanished.
units.literal: In the second year of Changxing of Tang, on the night of bingxu of the ninth month, at the beginning of the second drum, in the northeast there was a small shooting star that entered the leader of the Northern Dipper and was extinguished.

units.zh: 至五鼓初，西北方次北有流星，狀如半升器，初小後大，速流如奎滅。
units.en: By the fifth watch, north-northwest, a meteor shaped like a half-pint cup appeared, small at first then swelling as it streaked swiftly and vanished near the Striding Legs asterism.
units.literal: By the beginning of the fifth drum, north-northwest there was a shooting star shaped like a half-sheng vessel, at first small then large, streaming swiftly and being extinguished like the Striding Legs mansion.

units.zh: 尾跡凝天，屈曲似雲而散，光明燭地。
units.en: Its wake coiled across the sky, curling like clouds before dispersing, its light bright enough to light the ground.
units.literal: Its tail-trail congealed in the sky, bending and dispersing like clouds; its brilliance illuminated the ground.

units.zh: 又東北有流星如大桃，出下臺星，西北速流，至斗柄第三星旁滅。
units.en: Another meteor like a large peach rose in the northeast from the Lower Terrace star, streaked northwest, and vanished beside the third star of the Dipper's handle.
units.literal: Again in the northeast there was a shooting star like a large peach; it issued from the Lower Terrace star, streamed swiftly northwest, and was extinguished beside the third star of the Dipper's handle.

units.zh: 五鼓後至明，中天及四方有小流星百餘，流註交橫。
units.en: From the fifth watch until dawn, more than a hundred small meteors crossed the zenith and all quarters of the sky in intersecting trails.
units.literal: From after the fifth drum until dawn, at the center of the sky and in the four directions there were more than a hundred small shooting stars, streaming and crossing one another.

units.zh: 應順元年春，二月辛未夜，有大星如五升器，流於東北，有聲如雷。
units.en: In spring of the first year of Yingshun, on the night of xinwei in the second month a great meteor like a five-pint vessel streaked northeast with a thunderous roar.
units.literal: In the spring of the first year of Yingshun, on the night of xinwei of the second month, there was a great star like a five-sheng vessel, streaming toward the northeast, with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 清泰元年，九月辛丑夜，五鼓初，有大星如五斗器而南流，尾跡長數丈，亦赤色，移時盤屈如龍形，蹙縮如二鏵，相鬥而散。
units.en: In the first year of Qingtai, on the night of xinchou in the ninth month, at the fifth watch a great meteor like a bushel measure streamed south, its red tail trailing for many feet; for a while it writhed like a dragon, then contracted like two plow blades clashing before breaking apart.
units.literal: In the first year of Qingtai, on the night of xinchou of the ninth month, at the beginning of the fifth drum, there was a great star like a five-dou vessel streaming south; its tail-trail was several zhang in length and also red; after a time it coiled and bent like a dragon's form, contracted like two plowshares fighting, then dispersed.

units.zh: 又一星稍小，東流，有尾跡，凝成白氣，食頃方散。
units.en: A somewhat smaller star followed eastward, its trail condensing into white vapor that took the length of a meal to dissipate.
units.literal: Again a star somewhat smaller streamed east, with a tail-trail that congealed into white vapor and only dispersed after the time of a meal.

units.zh: 晉天福三年，三月壬申夜，四鼓後，東方有大流星，狀如三升器，其色白，長尺餘，屈曲流出河鼓星東三尺，流丈餘滅。
units.en: In the third year of Tianfu under Jin, on the night of renshen in the third month, after the fourth watch a great white meteor like a three-pint vessel appeared in the east, a little over a foot long; curving outward three feet east of the Drum at the River star, it streaked for more than ten feet and vanished.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu of Jin, on the night of renshen of the third month, after the fourth drum, in the east there was a great shooting star shaped like a three-sheng vessel; its color was white, its length more than a chi; bending and streaming, it issued three chi east of the Drum at the River star, streamed for more than a zhang, and was extinguished.

units.zh: 周顯德元年，正月庚寅，子夜後，東北有大星墜，有聲如雷，牛馬震駭，六街鼓人方寐而驚，以為曉鼓，乃齊伐鼓以應之，至曙方知之。
units.en: In the first year of Xiande under Zhou, on gengyin of the first month, after midnight a great meteor fell in the northeast with a thunderous roar; cattle and horses stampeded; the night-watch drummers of the Six Streets, roused from sleep, mistook it for the dawn signal and beat drums in unison until daybreak revealed the mistake.
units.literal: In the first year of Xiande of Zhou, on gengyin of the first month, after midnight, in the northeast a great star fell with a sound like thunder; oxen and horses were terrified; the drum-beaters of the Six Streets, just asleep, were startled, thinking it was the dawn drum, and all together beat drums in response; only at daybreak did they learn the truth.

units.zh: 三月，高平之役，戰之前夕，有大流星如日，流行數丈，墜於賊營之所。
units.en: In the third month, on the eve of the Gaoping campaign, a great meteor bright as the sun streaked for many feet and fell in the enemy camp.
units.literal: In the third month, on the eve of the battle at Gaoping, there was a great shooting star bright as the sun; it streamed for several zhang and fell upon the rebel camp.

units.zh: ◎雲氣
units.en: Cloud Vapors and Omens
units.literal: ◎ Cloud Vapors

units.zh: 梁開平二年，三月丁丑夜，月有蒼白暈，又有白氣如人形十餘，皆東向，出於暈內。
units.en: In the second year of Kaiping under Liang, on the night of dingchou in the third month the moon wore a pale bluish halo, and more than ten white vapors shaped like human figures, all facing east, emerged from within it.
units.literal: In the second year of Kaiping of Liang, on the night of dingchou of the third month, the moon had a pale blue-white halo, and again there were more than ten white vapors shaped like human forms, all facing east, issuing from within the halo.

units.zh: 九月乙酉，平旦，西方有氣如人形甚眾，皆若俯伏之狀，經刻乃散。
units.en: On yiyou of the ninth month at dawn, a great host of human-shaped vapors appeared in the west, all seeming to bow prostrate; they dispersed after about fifteen minutes.
units.literal: On yiyou of the ninth month, at daybreak, in the west there were very many vapors shaped like human forms, all as if in prostrate posture; after the time of a quarter-hour they dispersed.

units.zh: 唐同光三年，日有背氣，凡十二。
units.en: In the third year of Tongguang under Tang, opposing solar halos appeared twelve times.
units.literal: In the third year of Tongguang of Tang, the sun had opposing vapors; in all, twelve times.

units.zh: 三年，九月丁未夜，遍天陰雲，北方有聲如雷，四面雞雉皆雊，俗謂之「天狗落」。
units.en: In the third year, on the night of dingwei in the ninth month the sky was wholly overcast; thunder rolled in the north and fowl crowed on every side—the folk called it "the celestial dog falling."
units.literal: In the third year, on the night of dingwei of the ninth month, clouds covered the whole sky; in the north there was a sound like thunder, and on all sides chickens and pheasants crowed; popularly this is called "the celestial dog falling."

units.zh: 是歲，日有背氣，凡十三。
units.en: That year opposing solar halos appeared thirteen times.
units.literal: That year, the sun had opposing vapors; in all, thirteen times.

units.zh: 是月，司天監奏：「自七月三日陰雲大雨，至九月十八日後方晴，三辰行度災祥，數日不見。」
units.en: That month the astronomical directorate reported: "From the third day of the seventh month clouds and heavy rain persisted until after the eighteenth of the ninth month; for days we could not observe the sun, moon, and stars or read their omens."
units.literal: That month, the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "From the third day of the seventh month, with overcast clouds and heavy rain, until after the eighteenth day of the ninth month it finally cleared; the motions and degrees of the three luminaries and omens of disaster and blessing could not be seen for several days."

units.zh: 閏十二月庚午，日有黑氣，似日，交相錯磨，測在室十度。
units.en: On gengwu of the intercalary twelfth month a black vapor like a second sun appeared beside the disk, the two grinding against each other; observation placed it at the tenth degree of the Encampment asterism.
units.literal: On gengwu of the intercalary twelfth month, the sun had black vapor resembling a sun, grinding and crossing one another; measurement placed it at the tenth degree of the Encampment mansion.

units.zh: 天成二年，十二月壬辰，西方有赤氣，如火焰焰，約二千里。
units.en: In the second year of Tiancheng, on renchen of the twelfth month red vapor like leaping flames stretched across the western sky for some two thousand li.
units.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng, on renchen of the twelfth month, in the west there was red vapor like blazing flames, extending about two thousand li.

units.zh: 占者云「不出二年，其下當有大兵。」
units.en: Diviners said: "Within two years great armies will march in the region beneath it."
units.literal: The diviners said: "Within two years there will surely be great armies below it."

units.zh: 長興三年，六月，司天監奏：「自月初至月終，每夜陰雲蔽天，不辨星月。」
units.en: In the third year of Changxing, in the sixth month the astronomical directorate reported: "From the first to the last night of the month clouds shrouded the sky each night so that neither stars nor moon could be seen."
units.literal: In the third year of Changxing, in the sixth month, the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "From the beginning of the month to the end of the month, every night overcast clouds covered the sky and stars and moon could not be distinguished."

units.zh: 應順元年，四月九日，白虹貫日，是時閔帝遇害。
units.en: In the first year of Yingshun, on the ninth day of the fourth month a white rainbow pierced the sun; at that time Emperor Min was assassinated.
units.literal: In the first year of Yingshun, on the ninth day of the fourth month, a white rainbow pierced the sun; at that time Emperor Mindi was murdered.

units.zh: 晉天福初，高祖將建義於太原，日傍多有五色雲，如蓮芰之狀。
units.en: At the start of the Tianfu era, as Jin Gaozu prepared to raise his banner at Taiyuan, five-colored clouds like lotus pods gathered beside the sun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu of Jin, when Gaozu was about to raise righteous arms at Taiyuan, beside the sun there were many five-colored clouds shaped like lotus seed-pods.

units.zh: 二年，正月丙辰，一鼓初，北方有赤氣，向西至戌亥地，東北至醜地已來向北，闊三丈餘，狀如火光。
units.en: In the second year, on bingchen of the first month, at the first watch red vapor appeared in the north, stretching west toward the xu-hai quarter and from the northeast through the chou quarter northward, more than thirty feet wide and like blazing fire.
units.literal: In the second year, on bingchen of the first month, at the beginning of the first drum, in the north there was red vapor extending west to the xu and hai regions, and from the northeast to the chou region turning northward, more than three zhang in breadth, shaped like firelight.

units.zh: 赤氣內見紫微宮共北斗諸星，其氣乍明乍暗。
units.en: Within the red glow the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and the stars of the Northern Dipper could be seen, the vapor brightening and fading by turns.
units.literal: Within the red vapor could be seen the Purple Forbidden Palace together with the stars of the Northern Dipper; the vapor was now bright, now dim.

units.zh: 至三點後，後有白氣數條，相次西行，直至三鼓後散。
units.en: After the third point of the watch several streaks of white vapor followed one another westward until they dispersed after the third watch.
units.literal: After the third point, there were afterward several streaks of white vapor, one after another streaming west, until after the third drum they dispersed.

units.zh: 漢乾祐二年十二月，日暈三重，上有背氣。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the second year of Qianyou under Han, the sun showed a triple halo with an opposing arc above it.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Qianyou of Han, the sun had a triple halo with opposing vapor above it.

units.zh: 周顯德三年，十二月庚午，白虹貫日，氣暈勾環。
units.en: In the third year of Xiande under Zhou, on gengwu of the twelfth month a white rainbow pierced the sun, halos hooking and ringing around the disk.
units.literal: In the third year of Xiande of Zhou, on gengwu of the twelfth month, a white rainbow pierced the sun; vaporous halos hooked and ringed around it.
